task.question: What is the highest recorded temperature in Germany during the 2026 European heatwaves?
task.evidence: 27 June — 2026 European heatwaves: The highest recorded temperature in Germany is taken in Möckern-Drewitz, measuring 41.5 °C (106.7 °F).

answer: The highest recorded temperature in Germany during the 2026 European heatwaves was 41.7°C in Coschen on June 28th. FINAL: 41.7

[Weather tracker: Heatwave breaks June temperature records across Europe] UK provisional peak of 37.7C shatters previous record by huge margin, while Germany hits all-time high of 41.7C (https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/jul/03/weather-tracker-heatwave-breaks-june-temperature-records-across-europe)

Last week’s heatwave across western Europe shattered national June records and set new all-time highs.
The UK recorded a provisional high of 37.7C at Lingwood in Norfolk on Friday 27 June, smashing the previous June record of 35.6C, set in 1976. Such a margin is exceptionally rare: temperature records are typically broken by 0.1C or 0.2C, not a remarkable 2.1C.
Germany reached 41.7C in Coschen on 28 of June, breaking its all-time record for a third consecutive day. The Netherlands set a new June record with 39.4C on 26 June, while Hungary recorded an all-time high of 42C in Szécsény on 30 June.
The highest recorded temperature in Germany during the 2026 European heatwaves was 41.7°C in Coschen on June 28th. FINAL: 41.7
